Data Scientist.title: Data Scientist Career Roadmap
Data Scientist.description: Step-by-step roadmap to become a professional Data Scientist in 2026.

stages.title: Programming & Mathematics
stages.description: Master core computational and quantitative thinking essential for data modeling.

stages.title: Data Wrangling & SQL Analysis
stages.description: Learn to extract, clean, query, and transform unstructured and relational datasets.

stages.title: Supervised & Unsupervised Modeling
stages.description: Train predictive algorithms, evaluate generalization, and prevent overfitting.

stages.title: Deep Learning & Production Systems
stages.description: Work with neural networks, modern NLP transformers, and real-world deployment.

Machine Learning Engineer.title: Machine Learning Engineer Roadmap
Machine Learning Engineer.description: Architect, scale, and operationalize machine learning models in production.

stages.title: Computer Science & Applied Math
stages.description: Strong foundational programming, memory management, and linear algebra.

stages.title: Machine Learning Algorithms & Optimization
stages.description: Implement classical machine learning models and cost function optimization.

stages.title: Deep Neural Networks & Architectures
stages.description: Design Convolutional and Recurrent Networks, Transformers, and LLMs.

stages.title: Containerization & Cloud Serving
stages.description: Containerize models, setup automated CI/CD pipelines, and monitor model drift.

Full Stack Web Developer.title: Full Stack Web Developer Roadmap
Full Stack Web Developer.description: Master end-to-end web engineering across frontend, backend, databases, and deployment.

stages.title: HTML, CSS & Modern JavaScript
stages.description: Build responsive, accessible user interfaces with semantic markup and async JS.

stages.title: React Ecosystem & State Architecture
stages.description: Component-driven development, custom hooks, client-side routing, and state stores.

stages.title: Server Logic, APIs & Databases
stages.description: Design performant backend REST APIs, authentication layers, and database schemas.

stages.title: Cloud Hosting & Containers
stages.description: Containerize full-stack services with Docker and manage automated deployments.

Cloud Solutions Architect.title: Cloud & DevOps Solutions Architect Roadmap
Cloud Solutions Architect.description: Design fault-tolerant, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructures across AWS and GCP.

stages.title: Networking & Systems Fundamentals
stages.description: Core computer architecture, network topology, TCP/IP, and Linux administration.

stages.title: AWS & GCP Infrastructure Design
stages.description: Architect compute instances, high-availability VPC networks, and managed storage.

stages.title: Docker Containers & Kubernetes
stages.description: Standardize runtime environments with Docker and orchestrate microservices at scale.

stages.title: Data Pipelines & Automated Operations
stages.description: Automate cloud deployment with Terraform and manage enterprise big data warehouses.

Cybersecurity Analyst.title: Cybersecurity Analyst Roadmap
Cybersecurity Analyst.description: Protect network infrastructure, defend data assets, and conduct penetration tests.

stages.title: Networking & Security Architecture
stages.description: Understand network protocols, packet inspection, firewalls, and cryptographic basics.

stages.title: Security Operations & Incident Response
stages.description: Monitor logs, detect intrusions with SIEM platforms, and formulate triage responses.

stages.title: Web Application Penetration Testing
stages.description: Identify and exploit OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in modern web applications and APIs.

Mobile App Developer.title: Mobile App Developer Roadmap
Mobile App Developer.description: Build high-performance, polished native and cross-platform mobile applications.

stages.title: Object-Oriented Programming & Logic
stages.description: Solid algorithmic foundations, clean OOP, and data structures.

stages.title: Flutter & Dart App Development
stages.description: Build reactive multi-platform applications for iOS and Android with single codebase.

stages.title: Modern Kotlin & Jetpack Compose
stages.description: Master declarative native Android UI, asynchronous Coroutines, and local Room databases.
